game.title: Raazuvaa
game.description: The Maldivian version of chess with unique rules, believed to have evolved from incomplete transmission of chess knowledge. Pieces move differently while maintaining similar objectives.
equipment: Wooden board with distinctive Maldivian lacquer work
Any dark and light theme (not necessarily black/white)
howToPlay: Step 1: Board is set up with pieces in positions similar to chess but with variations.
Step 2: Pawns move differently than in standard chess.
Step 3: Castling rules may differ from international chess.
Step 4: King and queen placement follows local tradition.
Step 5: Objective remains to checkmate the opponent's king.
Step 6: Players alternate moves, strategizing to control the board.
Step 7: Pieces have distinctive Maldivian carved patterns.
Step 8: The game develops concentration and strategic thinking.
Step 9: Boards are often decorated with traditional lacquer work.
Step 10: Popular as a souvenir representing Maldivian culture.
